purpose: Define the deterministic JSON asset shape emitted by the canonical asset pump.

field_contracts.source_operation: Profile or composition operation used by the pump.
field_contracts.asset_kind: Source asset class such as primitive, loft, or compound.
field_contracts.architectural_role: Human-readable source role from the recipe.
field_contracts.generation_use: List of intended gameplay or generation uses.
field_contracts.semantic_tags: List of legal semantic geometry tags from geometry_dictionary.
field_contracts.connectors: List of connector anchors derived from local bounds.
field_contracts.components: List of source component references for compound assets; empty for primitive assets.
field_contracts.bounds_m: Local min/max coordinate bounds in abstract meters.
field_contracts.dimensions_m: Width, depth, and height derived from bounds_m.
field_contracts.mesh: Deterministic local mesh JSON with vertices and polygon faces.
field_contracts.no_claims: Required false-claim block copied from source recipe.

connector_contract.direction: Three finite numbers describing connector orientation.

component_contract.translation_m: Three finite local offsets in abstract meters.

mesh_contract.vertices: List of [x, y, z] finite numeric coordinates rounded by the pump.
mesh_contract.faces: List of polygon faces using zero-based vertex indices.

non_goals: This contract does not define a production asset pack.
This contract does not define Blender scene source logic.
This contract does not imply structural, fabrication, or historical accuracy.
This contract does not define game-engine integration.
